clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul trains rogues and serves the Shattered Hand. He directs covert work across Kalimdor and brings promising rogues into its ranks.

Shenthul trains rogues in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. While warriors and shamans march openly across Durotar, he teaches stealth, ambush, and subterfuge. His students learn fieldcraft and lethal arts for work in Kalimdor's harsh wilderness and unforgiving politics.

Shenthul speaks for the Shattered Hand, once an orcish clan and now the Horde's intelligence network and secret service. He describes it as a watchful presence across Kalimdor, investigating, judging, and carrying out its own sentences. Pragmatic and independent of shifting politics, Shenthul reminds outsiders that the Shattered Hand existed before Warchief Thrall took power and will endure after him.
